items.answer: Closely spaced contours show a steep slope, and the contour interval is the elevation difference between adjacent contour lines.
accepted: Close contours mean a steeper slope; contour interval is the vertical elevation change from one contour to the next.

items.rationale: The answer must cover both steepness from spacing and the vertical-elevation meaning of the contour interval.
